# Milestone brief — ui-uplift-m8

**Title:** Retire .card; adopt the graded hairline rule ladder
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** ui-uplift (plans/ui-uplift/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** next
**Target:** 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-19

## Parent epic

- ui-uplift-e1 — Material and type foundation — the D-1 Ledger Sheet core
  Replace the stitched two-source palette (a self-documented GitHub-Primer dark clone plus an unattributed bespoke light block) with one authored OKLCH family; author the product's first real type scale and its first letter-spacing; then retire .card as a primitive in favour of a graded hairline rule ladder. These three are the signature direction and they are strictly ordered — the rule ladder cannot ship before the material, because rules become the sole structural device and the light border token is 1.342:1 today.

## Summary

UPL-2. Delete the universal container. Three rule weights, horizontal only, no vertical edges; radius 0 on structure and 4px surviving only on interactive controls, so geometry itself encodes structure-versus-control. The rounded bordered card IS shadcn's identity and seven identical ones is the literal measured form of the complaint — deleting the primitive is the move a default assembly never makes. BLOCKED BY m6 and m7.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given the detail page, when rendered, then no .card primitive remains and structure is carried by three rule weights
2. Given --card-bg, then its successor role is stated explicitly — control ground for inputs and table headers, not panel ground — because three dark-mode rules still depend on it
3. Given the papers table, then its column-header separation has migrated to a rule weight, because the th background is 1.14:1 on white today and vanishes once the card ground goes
4. Given light mode, when rules carry structure alone, then the rule token clears SC 1.4.11's 3:1 non-text bar (it is 1.342:1 today)
5. Given the type scale from m7, then it has shipped — without it this milestone degrades to 'the same page with the borders removed', which is a worse outcome than shipping neither

## Depends on

- ui-uplift-m6 — Author one OKLCH material family + duration tokens (v0: the 8 tokens) [status: planned]
- ui-uplift-m7 — Author a two-voice type scale [status: planned]
